widgets.value:
# Agents Platform Runners
Reports which CLI runners (`claude`, `codex`, `copilot`, `cursor-agent`) are installed on this workspace, and registers them with `agents-platform-multitenant`'s Runners registry so agent model configs can reference this workspace's runners.

Registration is **idempotent** — clicking it again updates the existing entries instead of creating duplicates (dedup key: workspace + CLI).

widgets.title: Requirements
items: agents_platform_token must be set in this app's config (Settings) — a valid aw-backend identity JWT
agents_platform_base defaults to the agentic-workspace bridge gateway reaching agents-platform-multitenant :10014
